title: Revenue Operations Reporting Specialist
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Reporting Specialist to own the build and ongoing maintenance of our GTM reporting. This is a focused, execution\-oriented role: the Specialist produces and maintains reports and dashboards in Salesforce (SFDC) and other sources to defined specifications, keeps the existing reporting library accurate and current, and works from a structured request queue.
   

  

 The role is designed to be delivered by an offshore resource working in close, documented coordination with our onshore Revenue Operations team. The Salesforce Reporting Specialist does the hands\-on building, refreshing, and quality\-checking of the reports.
   

  

 This is a full\-time role with overall accountability to the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations \& Analytics.
   

  

***Preferred Location and Expected Work Hours***
 This role is based in Kochi, India. Given the need for real\-time collaboration with Dodge's US\-based GTM team, candidates should be comfortable working hours that overlap with US time zones, generally 12:00\-8:00 PM IST.
   

  

***Travel Requirements***
 Expected travel is less than 5% of the time but may occasionally be required for team meetings.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Build new Salesforce reports, custom report types, and dashboards to written specifications provided by the onshore Revenue Operations team
* Maintain, update, and troubleshoot the existing library of Salesforce reports and dashboards, keeping filters, groupings, and data sources accurate and current
* Build and refresh Business Intelligence dashboards and their underlying data extracts to defined specifications
* Perform routine quality assurance on reports and dashboards—verifying accuracy, checking for broken filters or stale data, and confirming figures reconcile to source
* Manage the report and dashboard catalog, including folder structure, naming conventions, and sharing and visibility settings
* Execute and monitor scheduled report refreshes and recurring distributions, confirming successful delivery
* Document report logic, field definitions, and change history so that reporting is transparent and reproducible
* Work a structured request/ticket queue, delivering standard reporting changes within agreed service\-level timeframes
* Log and escalate data discrepancies and suspected upstream data issues to the onshore team for root\-cause resolution
* Regression\-test reports and dashboards following Salesforce releases, additional Dodge hiring and role changes, or configuration changes, and flag anything that breaks


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or technical field, and/or equivalent work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 2\+ years building and maintaining reports and dashboards in Salesforce
* Proficiency with the Salesforce report builder, custom report types, and dashboards
* Experience building or maintaining dashboards in Tableau, QuickSight or other comparable Business Intelligence tool
* Strong Excel skills, including lookups and pivot tables
* Excellent written English and clear, asynchronous communication for documented coordination across time zones
* Highly detail\-oriented, with comfort working from specifications, queues, and service\-level expectations
* Reliable availability to overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM\-201\) or equivalent
* Exposure to Salesforce CPQ reporting
* Familiarity with SQL or other data\-preparation tools
* Prior experience working as part of a distributed or offshore delivery team


**About Dodge Construction Network**
 Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision\-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting\-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
   

  

 Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

* Previous project management experience
